LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Capacity, part of Measurement in Grade 4 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How can you measure capacity using arbitrary units?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. measure capacity of containers using a one-litre container,

2. work with peers in making litre containers from locally available materials through filling and emptying the container with substances such as water or sand using a 1 litre container,

3. make litre containers through filling and emptying using a 1 litre container,

4. team up with peers to use litre and litre containers to measure capacity of other containers,

5. add capacity involving litres,

6. subtract capacity involving litres,

7. play games involving capacity using containers of different capacities or use digital devices for digital games.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. measure capacity of containers using a one-litre container,
2. work with peers in making litre containers from locally available materials through filling and emptying the container with substances such as water or sand using a 1 litre container,
3. make litre containers through filling and emptying using a 1 litre container,
4. team up with peers to use litre and litre containers to measure capacity of other containers,
5. add capacity involving litres,
6. subtract capacity involving litres,
7. play games involving capacity using containers of different capacities or use digital devices for digital games.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: learner makes 1⁄2 litre containers from locally available materials through filling and

emptying the container with substances such as water or sand using a one-litre container.

• Self-efficacy: learner shows confidence in measuring capacity of 1⁄2 litre and 1⁄4 litre.

Values:
Responsibility: learner makes 1⁄4 litre containers from locally available materials through filling and emptying

the container with substances such as water or sand using a one-litre container.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety: learner observes precautionary measures while determining 1⁄2 litre and 1⁄4 litre containers.

• Environmental Education: learner uses 1⁄2 litre containers made from locally available materials.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate practical activities involving measurement of liquids to properties of matter in

Science and Technology.
